front: (HL) Complex number, real part, imaginary part?
back: $z = a + bi$ with $a, b \in \mathbb R$, $i^2 = -1$. $\text{Re}(z) = a$, $\text{Im}(z) = b$ (a real number, not $bi$).

front: (HL) How is $z = a + bi$ shown on an Argand diagram?
back: As the point $(a, b)$ (real axis horizontal, imaginary vertical). $|z|$ is its distance from $O$, $\arg z$ the angle from the positive real axis; $z^*$ is its reflection in the real axis.

front: (HL) Modulus of a product and quotient?
back: $|zw| = |z||w|$ and $\left|\dfrac zw\right| = \dfrac{|z|}{|w|}$. But $|z + w| \le |z| + |w|$, not equal in general.
